acceptance.limits: Installed-wheel fixture timings are synthetic; real repository push measurements will be recorded at publication. The exact opted-in POSIX offline recipe is supported. Arbitrary suites, cross-checkout reuse and external-network tests are outside this slice. No token savings measured.

body.scope: No dependencies, policy gates, CI or permission profile changed. The offline opt-in environment contract is documented; full network-dependent suites must retain ordinary execution.
body.verification: All 261 packaged Python files from the exercised wheel match the merged source exactly. Real installed-wheel metadata commit and native pushes, including another host tool call, reuse the code result. The changed-source control executes and fails. All ordinary-environment controls pass.
